# ScribeCat 0.26.0

### PDF viewer
- Fix the root cause of overview width and height following the previously rendered PDF page: single-page and overview surfaces now have separate DOM identities.
- Fill the viewer with a fixed two- or three-column grid and center complete PDF pages in each cell. Center incomplete rows without changing the column size.
- Reattach trackpad zoom and resize observation after restoring a minimized viewer or moving into mobile fallback fullscreen.
- Render a newly opened PDF even when it has the same page count as the previous document.
- Handle failed page and thumbnail loads with the viewer error state instead of unhandled promises.

### Reliability
- Preserve unsaved edits when a slower duplicate document read finishes, and ignore document reads from a vault that has been closed or replaced.
- Give concurrent server writes unique temporary files so simultaneous saves cannot overwrite each other's temporary data or fail with spurious missing-file errors.
- Resolve percent-encoded managed attachment names during copying and orphan checks; encode rewritten paths and preserve link labels.
- Unsubscribe folder watchers whose asynchronous registration finishes after the view has closed.

### Release
- Update desktop, server, Tauri and Docker versions to 0.26.0.
- Add regression coverage for PDF transitions, document read races, attachment references, watcher cleanup and concurrent server saves.
